title: Synthetic hackathon test: Block A concrete

findings.criterion: Concrete must reach 25 MPa at 28 days.
findings.explanation: Both the submitted lab report (evidence-1) and the attributed inspection notes (inspection-1) consistently report the concrete strength as 22 MPa at 28 days, which is below the required 25 MPa.

report.uncertainty: No uncertainty regarding the reported strength value, as evidence and inspection notes align. However, the authenticity and independence of the data sources are not verified.
report.summary: The sole criterion is not satisfied. Reported concrete strength (22 MPa) is below the required 25 MPa at 28 days, based on consistent but unverified evidence.
